sn54.2:1.1: bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ||
sn54.2:1.2: katham bhāvitā ca bhikkhave ānāpānasati katham bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 4.
sn54.2:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ānāpānasatisahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ ||
sn54.2:1.4: ānāpānasatisahagatam dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ || viriya || pīti || passaddhi || samādhi ||
sn54.2:1.5: ānāpānasatisahagatam upekkhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggaparināmiṃ || || 5.
sn54.2:1.6: Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānasati evam bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ti || || 1--2. Sāvatthi || ārāme ||
